title: Regulatory disposition — structural placeholder
description: Attributable, scoped regulation of exact motion, preserving refusal and answerable HOLD without general exclusion.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

attribution.description: Answerable bearer of the scoped regulatory act.

scope.description: Smallest truthful boundary of the effect, leaving unrelated motion distinct.

time.description: Temporal scope and currentness of the disposition.

posture.description: Supported regulation, such as admitting, bounding, pausing, redirecting, holding, refusing, or ending; no closed enumeration is prescribed.

basis.description: Applicable law, supported State, capacity account, and exact Authority where required.

effect.description: Actual constraint or change, distinct from its legitimacy or intended effect.

held_condition.description: For HOLD, the exact uncertainty, conflict, capacity, safety, or boundary preserved without deciding it.

review.description: How a materially constraining HOLD remains reviewable.

correction.description: How a materially constraining HOLD remains correctable.

ending.description: How the disposition can end at its exact scope; time alone does not make HOLD final.

uncertainty.description: Remaining missing support or conflict without wider Authority inferred.
